name: What's the difference between under-cabinet lighting and in-cabinet lighting?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between under-cabinet lighting and in-cabinet lighting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Under-cabinet lighting is installed on the underside of upper cabinets to illuminate the countertop directly below, providing essential task lighting for food preparation. In-cabinet lighting, conversely, is placed inside cabinets, often with glass fronts, to showcase dishes or decorative items. Both contribute to kitchen ambiance but serve different functional and aesthetic purposes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Under-cabinet lighting illuminates countertops for tasks, while in-cabinet lighting highlights items inside cabinets.
